name: Dark Sacrifice
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from Devouring Plague. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ah, a wonderful day for you, adventurer. I can see by the lessons you've learned that the time has come to send you back to Aelthalyste. There are things only she can teach you, and even then, only if you prove worthy.

I will not spoil the surprise for you, but I remember when I was a young priest learning about true power... divine power. Yes, those were the days.

Go back to Aelthalyste in the Undercity, adventurer. She will be awaiting you in the War Quarter.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, adventurer. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
